name: Bogdan Achebe-Svanstrom
location: The Shelf, near Pulaski and Chicago Ave

physical_description.build: Lean and weathered, with the posture of someone who has absorbed decades of street tension. Shoulders still broad but slightly rounded from age. Forearms corded with veins and old scar tissue.
physical_description.hair_color: Salt-and-pepper grey, natural with occasional white streaking
physical_description.hair_style: Kept short, close-cropped, groomed but unpretentious
physical_description.eye_color: Amber-brown, fading slightly with age cataracts beginning at edges
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep bronze, mixing dark West African undertones with pale Scandinavian heritage — a lived-in complexion
physical_description.complexion: Heavily lined face with deep grooves around eyes and mouth. Jaw still defined. Three-day stubble most days. Skin shows sun damage and years of chemical exposure — slight pockmarking on left cheek and forehead.
distinguishing_marks: Burn scar running from left temple down to jawline, roughly 8cm long, silvery and puckered
Faded tattoo on right forearm — Cyrillic characters partially covered by later scarring, circa 2190s gang mark he no longer acknowledges
Missing top molar on left side, dental plate visible when he speaks
Thin surgical scar under left eye from optic nerve repair (2204), barely visible
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Left eye has faint neon-green circuit tracery visible around the iris in low light — subcutaneous neural relay for encrypted comms. Fingertips on right hand show chrome capping at knuckles, industrial-grade synthetic bone reinforcement from a factory accident in his 40s. No flashy chrome — utility work, well-worn.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves economically, never wasting motion. Slight limp favoring right knee on cold mornings. Sits with his back to walls. Hands rest open, not clenched — a sign of practiced calm. When he talks, his jaw moves slowly, deliberately. Chain-smokes synthetic cigarettes, the kind that leave no tar but taste like burnt plastic.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4-5 practicality. Worn charcoal long-coat with reinforced elbow patches, synthetic leather underneath. Black thermal underlayer visible at collar. Cargo pants with multiple pockets, Φ200 knockoff boots resoled twice. A faded Milwaukee Wolves sports cap from the 2180s he never removes. Single stainless steel ring on left hand — no identifying marks. Layers suggest someone always ready to move quickly.
